summary: KFIT iteration 7 — guided videos with level-variant image, interactive rest/work timer, synchronised subtitles (overlay + burned-in), real-time durations. ALL REQUIREMENTS PASS. Video element duration matches meta.duration within 2 s (push-ups beginner fr: video 300.6 s vs meta 300.6 s, diff 0.00 s). (C) CUES: every rest segment contains a 'Série k sur n' / 'Set k of n' / 'Serie k de n' announcement whose end ≈ rest.end; every rest with duration ≥ 30 s additionally has a cue starting with 'Pour la prochaine série' / 'For the next set' / 'Para la próxima serie'; every meta ends with a 'Bravo…' / 'Great…' / 'Bravo…' final cue; cues are non-overlapping in every meta. On Push-ups, the LAST visible <video> currentSrc = '…/sample-push-ups.intermediate.fr.mp4' (default = exercise's own level). Changing exercise-level-{beginner,intermediate,advanced} swaps the file to '.<lvl>.fr.mp4' every time, for Push-ups, Goblet Squat and Plank (all 3 × 3 FR checks). Spot checks: Push-ups advanced EN → 'sample-push-ups.advanced.en.mp4'; Goblet Squat beginner ES → 'sample-goblet-squat.beginner.es.mp4'. (E) INTERACTIVE TIMER (Push-ups beginner FR, 300.6 s, sets 3, reps 8-10 → 30 s, rest 60 s): seek into W1 middle (~100 s) → video-timer-work visible, label 'SÉRIE 1/3', video-timer-value '0:14' matches ceil(W1.end-currentTime)=14 s (±1). Seek into R1 middle (~145 s) → video-timer-rest visible, label 'REPOS', value '0:29', video-rest-add ('+15 s') and video-rest-skip ('Passer') visible. Press video-rest-add → video paused=True, value grows from 0:29 → 0:43 (+14 s with 1 s tick latency); wait 17 s → video resumed by itself (paused=False, currentTime advanced). Press video-rest-add twice on R2 → value grows 0:29 → 0:59 (+30 s). Press video-rest-skip on R2 (middle=234.4 s, end=264.4 s) → currentTime jumps to 260.5 s (expected ≈ 259.4 s, +1 s tolerance), video plays again. Seek to intro (t=2 s) → both video-timer-work and video-timer-rest panels hidden (0 count). (F) SUBTITLES: video-subtitles visible under the video; video-subtitles-toggle hides/shows them (count 1→0→1) and now EMITS aria-checked (true → false → true), closing the iteration-6 minor a11y gap. (G) BURNED-IN SUBTITLES & COUNTDOWNS verified on screenshots: during a work segment (Push-ups beginner W2), the picture itself shows 'SÉRIE 2 SUR 3  13 s' overlay at the top-left; during a rest segment (R1 ≈ t=117 s), the picture shows a large centred 'REPOS 55 s' with the frame darkened AND the French subtitle 'Repos, 60 secondes. Respire et récupère.' burned at the bottom of the video — all exactly as specified. (H) FALLBACK: Burpees (no media_path) shows video-unavailable (and video-player absent), no crash.
